options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Alliance
options.doc: Which alliance your character belongs to.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
What is required to complete the game.
Main Quest: Complete the base game's main questline (God of Schemes).
Final Zone Quest: Complete the final quest in the goal zone.

options.name: Zone Count
options.doc:
Number of zones to include in the randomizer.
Set to 0 to include all available zones.
The generator will ensure connectivity from your starting zone to the goal.
(Note at least 4 are required for main quest goal)
options.doc_fr:
Nombre de zones à inclure dans le randomiseur.
Régler à 0 pour inclure toutes les zones disponibles.
Le générateur assurera la connectivité de votre zone de départ au but.
(Note au moins 4 sont nécessaires pour le but principal de la quête)

options.name: Included Zones
options.doc:
Zones to include in the randomizer pool.
Leave empty to include all zones.
Coldharbour is automatically included when required by your goal.
Valid zones: Stros M'kai, Betnikh, Glenumbra, Stormhaven, Rivenspire, Bangkorai,
Alik'r Desert, Khenarthi's Roost, Auridon, Grahtwood, Greenshade, Malabal Tor,
Reaper's March, Bleakrock Isle, Bal Foyen, Stonefalls, Deshaan, Shadowfen,
Eastmarch, The Rift, Craglorn, Coldharbour

options.name: Goal Zone
options.doc:
Which zone's final quest is the goal (only used when Goal is set to Final Zone Quest).
Any: The generator will pick a zone from your included zones.
Or select a specific zone.

options.name: Enable Main Quests
options.doc: Enable or disable checks for completing main quests
options.doc_fr: Activer ou désactiver les vérifications pour remplir les quêtes principales

options.name: Enable Zone Quests
options.doc: Enable or disable checks for completing zone quests
options.doc_fr: Activer ou désactiver les vérifications pour remplir les quêtes de zone

options.name: Enable Wayshrine Checks

options.name: Delves Per Region

options.name: Wayshrine Locking
options.doc: Restricts the ability to fast travel to wayshrines behind an item, Requires wayshrine checks to be enabled

options.name: Gold Cap
options.doc: What you want your starting gold cap to be without any items, set to 0 to turn off gold limiting

options.name: Infinite Wallet
options.doc: Adds an infinite wallet item to the multiworld that holds unlimited money
options.doc_fr: Ajoute un élément de portefeuille infini au multimonde qui détient de l'argent illimité
